words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) begins by pointing back, so the ayah does not introduce a new moral type from scratch. Its masculine plural form gathers the believers shaped in 90:17 by faith, endurance-counsel, and mercy-counsel, not the nearby abstract mercy noun alone. Because it is the subject of a verbless verdict clause, the earlier verbal process is now held still as identity: that delimited group is titled {{ar:أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābu al-maymanati}}). The transition comes without a wa- or fa- connector, so the prior sequence is resolved into a verdict rather than simply coordinated with another act. The distal demonstrative also gives the discourse-near group evaluative prominence, and its long, fused opening shape lets the act of pointing linger before the compact title arrives.

topics.headline: resolved prior group
topics.summary: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) points to the plural human group already formed in 90:17.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the right-side title belongs to the exact faith, patience, and mercy community described in 90:17, not to an open class of good people.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence resolves the masculine plural demonstrative back to the preceding plural relative group, and QAC identifies it as a nominative demonstrative subject.

topics.headline: verdict subject
topics.summary: As the subject of a nominal clause, {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) sets up an identity judgment rather than another narrated action.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 90:18 classifies the already described group in the present shape of a verdict, rather than adding one more deed to the list.
topics.reason: The clause is syntactically forced as nominal, with {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) as subject and the construct title as predicate.

topics.headline: evaluative distance
topics.summary: The distal form gives prominence and separation to a referent that is discourse-near from 90:17.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that distance is not mainly physical here; the demonstrative lifts the prior group into marked evaluative view before naming them.
topics.reason: The referent is immediately recoverable from 90:17, so the distal force is best read as evaluative prominence rather than spatial remoteness.

topics.headline: boundary compression
topics.summary: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) gathers the prior plural actions into one deictic subject at the ayah boundary.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hinge from process to status: multiple acts in 90:17 are compressed into one pointer before the title is pronounced.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is a single fused deictic unit at the start of a new nominal clause, and the attachment evidence keeps its antecedent in the prior ayah.

topics.headline: long deictic onset
topics.summary: The extended recited shape of {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) lets the pointing act occupy the opening of a very short ayah.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sound of the opening delays closure, making the pointer itself felt before the title arrives.
topics.reason: The phonetic payoff is not contradicted by the grammar; it supports the same opening deictic role rather than creating a separate parse.

words.prose: {{ar:أَصْحَٰبُ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābu}}) is the predicate head that turns the pointer into a social and eschatological title. It is plural and human, so the classification lands on the people described in 90:17 rather than on the abstract qualities of patience or mercy. Its construct bareness is not looseness: the word leans forward into {{ar:ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ}} ({{tr:al-maymanati}}), making belonging to the right-side domain inseparable from the name. The root field of {{ar:ص ح ب}} ({{tr:ṣ-ḥ-b}}) keeps association and attachment audible, so the title means a settled people-of status, not casual friendship or a new action. The form also participates in the familiar right-hand companion field, including 56:27, while 90:18 keeps its exact {{ar:ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ}} ({{tr:al-maymanati}}) wording marked beside broader right-hand formulas, grounds that title in the local path of faith, patience, and mercy, and prepares the side-flipped counterpart in 90:19.

topics.headline: human predicate class
topics.summary: {{ar:أَصْحَٰبُ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābu}}) predicates a plural human class of the demonstrative subject.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title names the people formed by the prior ethic, not patience or mercy as abstractions.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:أَصْحَٰبُ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābu}}) as a broken masculine plural nominative predicate, and attachment evidence links it to the demonstrative subject.

topics.headline: construct-bound title
topics.summary: The bare construct head is completed and defined by {{ar:ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ}} ({{tr:al-maymanati}}).
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the companions cannot be understood apart from the final right-side value term; the phrase is one bound title.
topics.reason: The attachment pass marks an iḍāfa relation from {{ar:أَصْحَٰبُ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābu}}) to the final genitive, so the apparent bareness is construct dependency rather than indefiniteness.

topics.headline: belonging over casual friendship
topics.summary: The {{ar:ص ح ب}} ({{tr:ṣ-ḥ-b}}) field supplies companionship and attachment, while the domain complement narrows it to people-of belonging.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title pictures durable attachment to a domain: companion, possessor, and people-of senses converge, while casual friendship is not the local force.
topics.reason: V4 accepts association and accompaniment for {{ar:ص ح ب}} ({{tr:ṣ-ḥ-b}}), but the genitive complement is a side or station, so the local sense is people attached to or characterized by that domain.

topics.headline: participial cohort form
topics.summary: The active-participial plural turns association into a standing class label with no event-time boundary.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names people by a durable relational identity, not by a finite act or by a simple reward noun.
topics.reason: QAC gives the local form as a noun from the active-participial pattern, and contextual data shows the form functioning strongly as a nominal classing expression.

topics.headline: right-side formula field
topics.summary: {{ar:أَصْحَٰبُ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābu}}) participates in a recurrent companion-side title field, including 56:27.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 90:18 is not an isolated label; it specializes a familiar right-hand companion title by tying it to faith, patience, and mercy.
topics.reason: The row-provided formula evidence is coherent with the local construct title; 56:27 is retained as a concrete formula parallel without controlling the local wording.

topics.headline: route becomes identity
topics.summary: The predicate title converts the ethical sequence of 90:17 into a compact identity.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that faith, patience-counsel, and mercy-counsel are not restated; they are resolved into the name of the people.
topics.reason: The word sits between the backward-pointing demonstrative and the final genitive domain, so it bridges prior conduct into classification.

topics.headline: paired title and sound
topics.summary: The same companion head prepares the opposite side-title in 90:19, while its heavier cluster precedes the softer final word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both architecture and sound: 90:18 establishes the positive half of a paired classification that 90:19 will reverse, and the heavier title onset gives way to the final side word.
topics.reason: The same head recurs in 90:19 with a changed side-term, and the local adjacency of the construct pair supports reading the phrase as a single formulaic unit.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ}} ({{tr:al-maymanati}}) completes the title and carries the verdict's landing weight. Its feminine singular genitive form is not adjective agreement with {{ar:أَصْحَٰبُ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābu}}); it is the iḍāfa complement that defines what kind of companions are meant. The root field of {{ar:ي م ن}} ({{tr:y-m-n}}) lets right side, blessing, and favorable allotment meet, while the rare meem-form steers the word toward a domain or station rather than merely a hand, oath, or other branch. As the final word, it turns the mercy-and-patience community of 90:17 into a spatially and morally favorable classification, anticipates the opposite side-term in 90:19, and joins the exact maymanah and mashʾamah sorting of 56:8-9 while still resonating with the wider right-hand title field. Its nasal close and shared -ah cadence carry the sound handoff from mercy into right-side classification and toward the coming contrast.

topics.headline: definite genitive completion
topics.summary: {{ar:ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ}} ({{tr:al-maymanati}}) is the definite genitive tail that completes the construct predicate.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause's identity claim remains incomplete until the final value-domain arrives and defines the companions.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a definite feminine singular genitive complement governed by {{ar:أَصْحَٰبُ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābu}}), not as an agreeing adjective.

topics.headline: single known pole
topics.summary: The definite singular form treats right-side auspiciousness as a known classification pole.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun names one recognizable category, not one favorable trait among many.
topics.reason: The singular definite nominal shape supports a stable domain reading, and no guardrail evidence contradicts that classification payoff.

topics.headline: right-side blessing
topics.summary: The {{ar:ي م ن}} ({{tr:y-m-n}}) field lets right side, blessing, and favorable allotment converge in the local title.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is both spatial and moral: the people are placed on the favorable side and associated with blessed allotment, while oath, Yemen, death, and bare hand branches are not selected.
topics.reason: V4 lists multiple accepted branches for {{ar:ي م ن}} ({{tr:y-m-n}}), but the local meem-form genitive inside the title selects the right-side blessed-domain branch and only allows the broader root field as pressure.

topics.headline: meem-form domain
topics.summary: The rare meem-form points toward a domain, station, or allotment rather than the ordinary hand form.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah selects a marked station-like form from a broad root family, concentrating the short verdict in this final word.
topics.reason: QAC tags the word as a GERUND_MEEM noun, and contextual evidence shows this exact form as low occurrence and tightly tied to the companion-side title.

topics.headline: formula and pairing
topics.summary: {{ar:ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ}} ({{tr:al-maymanati}}) belongs to the companion-side formula field and to the maymanah versus mashʾamah sorting in 56:8-9.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local title participates in a larger Quranic sorting formula, while 90:18 supplies faith, patience, and mercy as the local grammar behind that sorting.
topics.reason: The formula rows give concrete references, especially 56:8-9, and the local construct phrase supports a companion-side classification without needing any fallback routing.

topics.headline: same-surah opposite
topics.summary: The positive side-term prepares the antonymic counterpart in 90:19.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 90:18 is the first half of a paired classification, with the opposite side-term arriving in 90:19 rather than a new unrelated topic.
topics.reason: The next ayah supplies the antonymic side-term, making the local word a polarity marker in a same-surah pair.

topics.headline: mercy becomes status
topics.summary: The final word converts the mercy-and-patience boundary of 90:17 into a favorable side classification.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary movement from communal practice in 90:17 to spatialized destiny in 90:18.
topics.reason: As the terminal genitive complement, the word resolves the demonstrative and construct head into the value-domain that names the group.

topics.headline: nasal closure
topics.summary: The nasal texture and feminine closure link the final station-name with the surrounding mercy and contrast terms.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word does acoustic work too: it softens the close after the heavier companion head and connects mercy, right-side classification, and the coming contrast by cadence.
topics.reason: The sound rows are locally coherent with the same final-word position and do not conflict with the grammatical analysis.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct أَصْحَابُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ joins a plural relation noun to a noun of side and orientation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The companionship branch makes membership a sustained association, while the right-side branch supplies its axis. The phrase therefore classifies by durable side-affiliation rather than by a momentary location.

activation_trace.role: Sustained companionship turns أصحاب into a relational company whose members remain attached to a shared pole.
The right hand and right side give الميمنة a concrete directional pole for that continuing affiliation.

changed_reading.before: A bare deictic label: those are the people placed on the right.
changed_reading.after: A durable company whose identity is formed by continuing attachment to the right-hand side.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أصحاب can image accompaniment that keeps safe, and الميمنة can image blessing rather than geometry alone.
baseline_models.mechanism: Protective accompaniment and auspicious blessing combine into a condition of being kept in beneficent company. This reading coexists with the spatial one: rightness is experienced as a sheltering relation, not merely assigned as a coordinate.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment makes the company an active medium of keeping, calm, and aid.
Blessing and good fortune supply the favorable condition sustained by that accompaniment.

changed_reading.before: The group merely receives a favorable title.
changed_reading.after: They are a company held within protective accompaniment whose shared condition is blessing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus roots permit an active relation: something may be taken along as a fitting companion, and the right hand may signify power, restraint, and rightful force.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of naming passive occupants of a side, the phrase can name people whose companionship carries a fitting form of rightful power. The oddity is useful because it makes rightness a manner of bearing force rather than a badge.

activation_trace.role: Taking or making something accompany another supplies the active carrying relation in أصحاب.
Right-hand power, restraint, and rightful force identify what is carried and how the company is tested.

changed_reading.before: Rightness is a static place occupied by a fortunate group.
changed_reading.after: Rightness is a form of power carried as a fitting companion, making the group an active ethical alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening oath activates the otherwise latent oath sense of the focus-side noun. With أصحاب retaining sustained association, the right-hand company becomes a pledged company: its cohesion may be covenantal as well as spatial.

activation_trace.role: Close association supplies the people who can be held together by a shared pledge.
The right-hand oath turns الميمنة into a possible pledge-bearing term rather than only a side name.
An oath apportioned among its people supplies the opening covenantal trigger and a social distribution mechanism.

structural_cues: An oath opens the sequence long before the deictic أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ identifies the focus company.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening q-s-m oath and a y-m-n oath branch; I infer that the oath can bind the later company. The live alternative is that the oath only frames the discourse while الميمنة remains spatial or auspicious.

changed_reading.before: Those attached to the favorable or right-hand side.
changed_reading.after: Those held together as companions of a right-hand pledge, with side, blessing, and covenant all still available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Apportionment, bounded territory, and release from prohibition form a civic-juridical mechanism. The focus company can consequently be heard as an allotted constituency aligned with the rightful side inside a contested boundary, not just an after-the-fact crowd.

activation_trace.role: Sustained association gives the allotted persons the coherence of a civic body.
The side of rightful force supplies the juridical orientation of the constituency.
Separating and allotting a share supplies the classificatory act by which a company is assigned.
A bounded tract of land supplies the civic container within which side-membership can matter.
The dissolution of a prohibition introduces legal release as a way a bounded order can be reconfigured.

structural_cues: The same city is named in two consecutive ayat, with حِلّ placed inside the second bounded-city statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies allotment, a delimited land, and a lifted restriction; I infer a legal act that constitutes a right-aligned body. The alternative is three independent images serving oath, place, and permission without defining the focus group.

changed_reading.before: A company already found on the right side.
changed_reading.after: A civic body constituted by allotment, boundary, and lawful release toward the side of rightful force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parent-and-offspring frame activates the focus branch in which a son matures into a companion. Blessed company can thus be intergenerational: dependence ripens into reciprocal presence rather than lineage functioning only as descent.

activation_trace.role: A son growing old enough to become a companion supplies a temporal model for how company comes into being.
Blessing marks the matured intergenerational relation as a live reading of الميمنة.
Offspring from a line of descent activates generation as the source from which companionship may mature.

structural_cues: The paired nominal and verbal forms place parent and what is born in one compact generative frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parenthood, offspring, and the focus image of a son becoming a companion; I infer a dependency-to-reciprocity arc. The alternative is that 90:3 invokes generation generally without specifying the social mechanism of 90:18.

changed_reading.before: A blessed cohort whose members simply share a destination.
changed_reading.after: A blessed company that can be generated when inherited dependency matures into reciprocal companionship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation followed by centered struggle turns rightness into an embodied orientation maintained under load. Companionship is no longer merely co-location; it is the carrying of a fitting rightward alignment through the body's difficult center.

activation_trace.role: Making something fit and accompany supplies the carried alignment that persists through strain.
The bodily right side supplies a concrete orientation rather than an abstract favorable label.
Measured formation supplies a calibrated body in which directional alignment can be enacted.
Struggle and arduous exertion make maintaining that alignment costly rather than automatic.
The middle or heart of a thing locates struggle at an embodied center from which right and left diverge.

structural_cues: Creation, the human being, and كَبَد occur in a single predication immediately after the generative frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, hardship, and a central bodily image; I infer that right-side affiliation is practiced under centered load. The alternative is that كبد means hardship only and does not spatialize the focus phrase.

changed_reading.before: The company is deposited on a favorable side.
changed_reading.after: The company carries a rightward bodily fit through centered struggle, making orientation an achieved posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated suppositions of being unconstrained and unseen set solitary power against companionship. The right-hand force model changes accordingly: rightful capacity belongs to a visible, answerable company, while imagined isolation is the false mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Close association opposes the actor's fantasy of acting as an isolated, unanswerable unit.
Right-hand power and restraint make accountability a test of how capacity is held.
Supposition supplies the mistaken internal model of invulnerability that the focus company reverses.
Effective capacity supplies the power whose imagined limitlessness must be corrected.
Singularity and separation expose the solitary premise opposed by أصحاب.
Seeing by eye or insight restores visibility and answerability to conduct.

structural_cues: Two parallel أَيَحْسَبُ questions surround the expenditure boast and negate both unconstrained power and unseen action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mistaken supposition, capacity, singularity, and sight; I infer that companionship is the social form of accountable power. The alternative is exclusively divine surveillance, with no claim about relations among the focus group.

changed_reading.before: A fortunate group possessing superior power.
changed_reading.after: A company whose power is right because it accepts limit, visibility, and relation instead of solitary impunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exhausted wealth and material piled layer over layer activate the carrying sense of companionship. أصحاب can momentarily image people accompanied by what their expenditure has attached to them: a material record whose rightness depends on how capacity moved, not on the size of the pile.

activation_trace.role: Taking something along as a companion anchors the idea that acts and their material effects remain attached to actors.
Rightful capacity supplies the criterion by which the attached expenditure record is evaluated.
Exhausting effort or substance turns the boast into a claim about what has been spent away.
Possessing and multiplying wealth supplies the material capacity whose movement leaves a record.
Matter layered one part over another supplies the image of accumulated consequence rather than a neutral quantity.

structural_cues: The first-person boast about consumed wealth stands between paired questions about power and being seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spent capacity and layered matter; I infer that expenditure leaves an accompanying material trace. The alternative is that لبدًا only exaggerates quantity and never modifies the semantics of أصحاب.

changed_reading.before: Companions are only other persons sharing a side.
changed_reading.after: The right-side people are also those accompanied by an attached material history of how their capacity was spent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Endowed bilateral perception, gentle guidance, and two elevations convert the focus-side into a route. The company is formed by repeatedly taking and carrying one path, so rightness is trajectory and attachment rather than an unexplained sorting outcome.

activation_trace.role: Taking something along or fitting with it makes companionship a sustained route attachment.
The right side gives the chosen route a directional identity.
Setting something into a condition frames the faculties as enabling endowments rather than accidental anatomy.
The seeing eye supplies perception capable of orienting between alternatives.
Gentle direction toward a path or truth supplies the movement from capacity to orientation.
Elevation and high ground materialize the two alternatives as routes that must be climbed.

structural_cues: Paired eyes and lips precede the explicitly dual النجدين, creating a repeated bilateral architecture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired faculties, guidance, and two elevations; I infer that right-side affiliation is generated by maintained route choice. The alternative is a general two-path contrast with no special anatomical or companionship mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A durable attachment to a side already assigned.
changed_reading.after: A company continually formed by carrying the rightward route with endowed perception and guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gifted organs of speech become functional when the later doubled reciprocal counsel sends endurance and mercy from member to member. أصحاب الميمنة is thereby a communication circuit that companions people into blessing rather than a collection of independently qualified individuals.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment names the keeping effect produced by the reciprocal speech circuit.
Blessing is recast as a condition circulated and sustained among companions.
The tongue as a means of delivering a message supplies the transmission channel.
Speech passed from lip to lip supplies person-to-person relay rather than solitary utterance.
Exchanged counsel among a people closes the relay into a reciprocal social mechanism.
Bearing responsibility and staying with it gives the circuit durable load-bearing content.
Tender mercy supplies the other message whose circulation makes accompaniment protective.

structural_cues: Tongue and lips appear before the path test; تَوَاصَوْا is then repeated twice immediately before the deictic focus verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies message organs, lip-to-lip transfer, repeated mutual counsel, endurance, and mercy; I infer a feedback network that produces the company. The alternative is that the organs are generic gifts and the later counsel merely lists individual virtues.

changed_reading.before: People share blessing because each separately belongs to the right.
changed_reading.after: People become the blessed company by repeatedly accompanying one another through transmitted endurance and mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The difficult incursion, steep obstacle, and opening of a captive neck reverse the ordinary image of power. Rightful force proves itself by crossing resistance in order to unbind another; protective companionship is the social result of release.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment identifies the relation into which the released person can be restored.
Rightful force supplies the power whose direction is revised from domination toward release.
Entering hardship without protective hesitation supplies the costly motion required to confront constraint.
The steep, difficult rise materializes resistance rather than treating rightness as effortless status.
Releasing a pledge or neck from confinement supplies the decisive reversal from force-over to force-for.
The neck supplies the embodied captive whose restoration makes the power relation concrete.

structural_cues: The failed ascent is followed by a question and then by the compact nominal answer فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hazardous entry, a steep barrier, and release from confinement; I infer that these specify how right-hand power becomes rightful. The alternative is that emancipation is one meritorious act without redefining the focus-side.

changed_reading.before: The right-hand company possesses force and protection.
changed_reading.after: It becomes right-hand company by spending force to open confinement and return a captive body to protective relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Feeding amid exhausting hunger, attending to a child cut off from a keeper, and reaching the dust-bound poor make protective accompaniment into social infrastructure. The lineage baseline is revised: blessed company is generated by repairing broken dependence and widening kin-nearness through provision.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies the keeping relation that food and care materially enact.
Blessing becomes a circulated social condition rather than privately held good fortune.
Giving food to another supplies the concrete transfer by which accompaniment preserves life.
Hunger compounded by exhaustion supplies the pressure under which protective company becomes necessary.
A child severed from a keeper supplies the broken relation that companionship must repair.
Kinship proximity makes inherited relation an obligation rather than an entitlement.
The abasement of destitution supplies a second form of damaged social standing beyond orphanhood.
Poverty figured as adhesion to dust grounds the care mechanism at the lowest material level.

structural_cues: The alternatives move from releasing a neck to feeding, then name a near orphan and a dust-bound poor person as paired recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies food transfer, famine, severed guardianship, kin proximity, abasement, and dust poverty; I infer that repairing dependence constitutes the company itself. The alternative is that these are external proofs of membership rather than its relational mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Blessed company may arise when natural lineage matures into companionship.
changed_reading.after: Blessed company is made by repairing severed care, converting kinship into responsibility, and extending protection to the socially grounded poor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate syntactic mirror repeats أصحاب while replacing the focus pole with the left/ill-fortune pole. Companionship is therefore a valence-neutral structure of durable affiliation, while the paired side nouns carry both spatial and auspicious polarity.

activation_trace.role: Companionship supplies the repeated relational frame shared by both poles.
The right side establishes one half of the explicit spatial opposition.
Blessing preserves the auspicious valence that coexists with the spatial right.
The repeated companionship noun proves that durable affiliation itself does not determine favorable valence.
The left side supplies the geometrical counter-pole to the focus right side.
Ill fortune supplies the negative valence countering the blessing branch of الميمنة.

structural_cues: Two adjacent ayat use the same أصحاب-plus-pole construction with opposed pole nouns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact relational mirror and both spatial and fortune branches; I infer a two-axis polarity held inside one syntax. The alternative is a purely moral pair of conventional labels with no live geometry or branch interaction.

changed_reading.before: Right side and blessing blur into one favorable designation.
changed_reading.after: The phrase operates on two coexisting axes—right versus left and blessing versus ill fortune—while أصحاب marks durable affiliation on either side.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covering of a visible sign is followed by fire closed over its people. That sequence supports an abductive reversal: chosen covering becomes imposed enclosure. Against it, the focus companionship can be heard as protective rather than trapping, and blessed rightness as remaining open to what is shown.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies the non-trapping form of being held with others.
Blessing supplies the favorable alternative to an enclosure that closes over its occupants.
Blocking or veiling truth supplies the initial act of covering in the reversal.
A manifest sign supplies the visible object that is covered despite being available to perception.
Kindled fire supplies the hostile medium that comes to surround the counter-company.
Closing tightly over something completes the reversal from covering a sign to being covered by consequence.

structural_cues: Denial of signs and the sealed fire occur in consecutive clauses, with عَلَيْهِمْ placing the enclosure over the people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a covered truth, a manifest sign, kindled fire, and closure; I supply the directional reversal from chosen covering to imposed enclosure. The alternative is a simple punishment sequence without lexical reciprocity or implications for the focus company.

changed_reading.before: The right-side company is protected and fortunate in an unspecified way.
changed_reading.after: Its protective openness contrasts with a counter-company whose covering of visible signs returns as a trapping enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare focus branch in which dying is imaged by being laid on the right side, then lets the birth and final-fire frame span a whole life. It remains anchored directly in الميمنة and in the packet's birth-to-terminal sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a mortuary undertone, not as the phrase's primary translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rare death-on-the-right branch of ي م ن is grammatically lodged in الميمنة, while أصحاب supplies the company whose life-course reaches that posture.

activation_trace.role: Continuing companionship supplies the collective whose shared orientation can persist to death.
Dying as being laid on the right side supplies the unusual mortuary sense directly anchored in the focus noun.
The event of birth supplies the opening temporal edge of the proposed life-course frame.
The terminal kindled fire supplies an end-state context that makes a mortuary echo audible.

changed_reading.before: A social and moral company aligned with the right.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a birth-to-death company whose rightward alignment culminates in the body's final right-side posture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it joins accumulated wealth and feeding to the non-dominant و ص د image of a stone store for wealth in a mountain. It remains anchored through the focus branches of carrying accompaniment and blessing, and every context link is packet-backed; downstream prose should qualify the sealed-hoard contrast as a material analogy rather than claim that مؤصدة lexically means hoarding here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أصحاب can image carrying something along, while الميمنة can image blessing; together they can host a question about whether material blessing circulates or is sealed away.

activation_trace.role: Carrying something along supplies the material-transport relation by which wealth can enter company.
Blessing supplies the value that can either circulate through care or be immobilized as possession.
Accumulating wealth supplies the material stock whose social movement is at issue.
Layered matter supplies the image of a pile becoming increasingly immobile.
Feeding another supplies the opposite motion: stock leaves the pile and becomes sustaining relation.
The non-dominant stone store for wealth in a mountain supplies the sealed-hoard counterimage without replacing the surface sense of closure.

changed_reading.before: Blessed company is a static favorable state unrelated to material flow.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, blessed company is the circulation of carried wealth into sustenance, opposed by the image of accumulated value sealed in stone.

strongest_changes: The phrase shifted from a static destination label to a durable relation repeatedly made through route choice, accountable power, release, and care.
The steep-pass sequence revised right-hand force most sharply: power becomes rightful when it opens confinement and restores protective company.
Tongue, lips, and doubled reciprocal counsel turned companionship into a speech-mediated feedback network that circulates endurance and mercy.
The mirrored أصحاب construction preserved both spatial right-versus-left and blessing-versus-ill-fortune readings instead of forcing one sense.
The opening oath kept a distinct covenantal reading alive: a company bound by a right-hand pledge.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots behaved less like fixed labels than like relational operators. Context repeatedly changed what could be accompanied, carried, protected, allotted, released, or enclosed, allowing sworn, civic, intergenerational, embodied, economic, social, and terminal readings to coexist without merging them.
remaining_uncertainties: The relative weight of spatial right, blessing, oath, and rightful force in الميمنة remains deliberately unresolved.
The civic-allotment and attached-material-record models are well anchored by branches but depend on stronger reader-supplied causal arrows than the route and care models.
The reversal from covering signs to being enclosed is abductively coherent but may be rhetorical sequence rather than an intended lexical feedback.
The mortuary and sealed-hoard outliers should remain contained lexical undertones because they rely on a rare focus branch and a non-dominant mapped branch respectively.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Right-side as blessed companionship.** Lexical evidence: ص ح ب B001 “companionship/close association,” B002 “protective accompaniment,” ي م ن B001 “blessing and good fortune,” B002 “right hand/right side.” Structural cue: the demonstrative follows the community described in 90:17. Assigned role: أصحاب names a company formed by prior acts; الميمنة names the auspicious/rightward side they inhabit. Abductive move: I infer that right-side identity is produced through shared accompaniment in mercy and patience. Reading change: the ayah is less a label slapped on individuals and more a social location generated by companioned practice.

2. **Right hand as power used rightly.** Lexical evidence: ي م ن B004 “right hand as power/rightful force,” B003 “oath by the right hand.” Structural cue: the surah began with قسم/oath and tested claims about قدرة/power. Assigned role: يمين gathers oath, power, and auspicious side. Abductive move: I infer that true power is the hand that frees, feeds, and joins others. Reading change: “الميمنة” becomes rightful empowered orientation, not merely fortunate placement.

findings.text: Sağ tarafın insanları, tekil başarılarıyla yan yana gelmiş kişiler değil; ortak özgürleştirme, bakım ve öğüt pratikleriyle oluşmuş bir topluluktur.
Arkadaşlık, savunmasız kişileri zorlu yol boyunca koruyan ve kazanılan özgürlüğü zaman içinde sürdüren bir eşlik biçimidir.
Sağ taraf, yalnız bir konum değil; yeminin sınadığı gücün özgürleştirme ve doyurma için haklı biçimde kullanıldığı hayırlı yöndür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: age peers raised together `ت ر ب:B004/m01`; coeval by birth `و ل د:B006/m01`; son reaching companionable adulthood `ص ح ب:B005/m01`; noble full siblings `ع ي ن:B015/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Shared age becomes shared social capacity. Peers mature together, while the child-parent relation changes when the son can stand beside the father as a companion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Social proximity is created by descent, co-residence, chosen intimacy, and shared group membership.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Companionship reaches marriage, household inhabitants, confidants, comforting objects, noble siblings, and present witnesses.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Confidant, Solace, and Intimate Company
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A chosen companion removes estrangement and becomes a trusted source of comfort.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: companionship that removes loneliness `ء ن س:B003/m01`; intimate confidant `ء ن س:B006/m02`; continuing companion `ص ح ب:B001/m01`; object or person in whom the soul rests `س ك ن:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Intimacy is a change of state from estrangement to repose. The companion is not merely adjacent but actively makes the other feel settled.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Social and economic obligations persist through trust, debt, guarantee, testament, inheritance, and exchange.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Obligation extends to survivorship gifts, collateral inheritance, delayed payment, ready cash, credit sales, and the "neck" or principal of property.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Security, Trust, and Entrustment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fear is stilled because a reliable person guards what has been entrusted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: security and trustworthy custody `ء م ن:B001/m01`; guarding accompaniment `ص ح ب:B002/m01`; guardian or watchman `ر ق ب:B002/m01`; guarantor's continuing presence `ص ب ر:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Trust is operational rather than merely emotional: custody is accepted, guarding continues, and a responsible person remains answerable for the entrusted object or person.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Vulnerable persons and difficult actions are sustained through reciprocal instruction, self-command, compassion, and protective presence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Care appears as a companion who removes fear, a guarantor who stays, a warning against relapse, and a guard who preserves another through watchfulness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reciprocal Counsel
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Members of a community repeatedly direct one another toward conduct they must sustain together.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reciprocal injunction `و ص ي:B003/m01`; message relay `ل س ن:B008/m01`; negotiated discussion `ق و ل:B009/m01`; continuing companionship `ص ح ب:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Counsel is a circulating social process. Advice is voiced, relayed, considered with others, and maintained by companions who remain present to one another.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Vulnerable persons and difficult actions are sustained through reciprocal instruction, self-command, compassion, and protective presence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Care appears as a companion who removes fear, a guarantor who stays, a warning against relapse, and a guard who preserves another through watchfulness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mercy and Protective Care
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Compassion recognizes another's vulnerability and acts to preserve that person.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tenderness and beneficent mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; sincere concern for a matter or person `ق و ل:B015/m01`; protective accompaniment `ص ح ب:B002/m01`; guarding and preservation `ر ق ب:B002/m01`; trusted security `ء م ن:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Mercy becomes concrete through sincere concern, presence, and guarding. Feeling for another leads to accompaniment, and accompaniment creates the security in which the vulnerable person can remain safe.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Commitment is expressed through assent, sworn speech, expiation, responsive prayer, and offerings brought near.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ritual commitment reaches oath-release by a token act, "amen" as an answering formula, camouflaged sin erased by covering, and the offering's arrival at its lawful place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Oath, Testimony, and Sworn Right Hand
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A speaker invokes an oath and binds the truth of a statement to sworn testimony.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sworn oath `ق س م:B004/m01`; oath by the right hand `ي م ن:B003/m01`; oath-opening affirmation `ء ي ي:B010/m01`; allotted oaths in a blood claim `ق س م:B004/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Oath speech creates a binding relation between speaker, claim, and consequence. The right hand and distributed testimony give that relation bodily and communal form.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Commitment is expressed through assent, sworn speech, expiation, responsive prayer, and offerings brought near.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ritual commitment reaches oath-release by a token act, "amen" as an answering formula, camouflaged sin erased by covering, and the offering's arrival at its lawful place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Oath Release and Expiation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A binding oath or fault is discharged by a prescribed act that covers and removes its claim.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: token act releasing an oath `ح ل ل:B005/m01`; expiation that erases wrongdoing `ك ف ر:B009/m01`; penalty following breach `ع ق ب:B007/m01`; right-hand obligation `ي م ن:B003/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Release does not deny that a bond existed. A specified act answers the oath or fault, preventing its punitive consequence by satisfying the outstanding claim.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Action depends on counting, delimiting, possessing power, enduring constraint, and choosing after reflection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Measure also governs astronomical calculation, medium quality, coordinated horse footfall, adequacy, and expansive quantification under negation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Power, Ability, and Ownership
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person possesses sufficient control to perform an act or hold property.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: effective power and possession `ق د ر:B003/m01`; ability to accomplish a task `ط ع م:B011/m01`; strength and enforceable right `ي م ن:B004/m01`; choice property `ر ق ب:B012/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Capacity joins agency to control over resources. The person can act because power, right, and property are available to be exercised.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conflict exposes agents to danger, organized violence, hostility, restraint, and answering punishment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The conflict field includes sword-and-stick duels, blackened livers as enmity, ceasefire, forced oaths, retaliation, and protected asylum.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hostility, Feud, and Truce
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Enmity takes hold between groups and is then suspended by an agreed ceasefire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deep hostility figured as black livers `ك ب د:B007/m01`; feud or enmity `ن و ر:B007/m01`; negotiated truce `ق س م:B008/m01`; companion-group alignment `ص ح ب:B001/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Feud is a durable relation between aligned groups, not a single clash. Truce does not erase that relation but regulates it by suspending hostile action.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and objects become socially legible through proportion, color, trace, and adornment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Appearance includes an open brow, tawny animal color, skin disease, scars, sword straps, scabbards, crowns, and noble full siblings.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Complexion, Tawny Redness, and Skin Change
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Color in skin, hair, or hide identifies health, disease, and animal appearance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: mixed white-red or dusty complexion `ح س ب:B009/m01`; tawny-red animal hue `ص ح ب:B008/m01`; skin mark `ب ل د:B006/m01`; pallor or disease resembling leprosy `ح س ب:B009/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Color is diagnostic as well as decorative. Hue identifies the animal or person, while a changed patch can indicate disease or a lasting bodily event.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water is found, carried, leaked, surfaced, filtered, and retained through a set of natural and crafted containers.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Water appears as a spring, a leaking skin, algae on a surface, a beetle-filled pool, a strainer, a rock basin, and a night journey toward a watering place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Waterskin, Leak, and Casing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water is carried in a skin whose thin point may leak and whose outer casing protects it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: waterskin container `ق ر ب:B009/m01`; leaking aperture in skin `ع ي ن:B007/m01`; sewn casing around a waterskin `ل ب د:B004/m01`; hide retaining hair `ص ح ب:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The vessel is an assembly of hide, seam, casing, and vulnerable aperture. Its purpose is defeated by leakage, so carrying water depends on maintaining the integrity of every layer.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water is found, carried, leaked, surfaced, filtered, and retained through a set of natural and crafted containers.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Water appears as a spring, a leaking skin, algae on a surface, a beetle-filled pool, a strainer, a rock basin, and a night journey toward a watering place.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Water Surface, Algae, and Beetle Habitat
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Standing water develops a surface growth and supports small creatures within it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: algae covering water `ص ح ب:B007/m01`; water crowded with beetles `ج ع ل:B008/m01`; compacted surface layer `ل ب د:B001/m02`; still water or calm surface `س ك ن:B001/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The water body becomes a layered habitat. Stillness permits algae to spread, compact surface matter forms, and beetles inhabit the resulting environment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Fibers and skins are prepared, layered, worn, cased, or arranged to furnish bodies and dwellings.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Textile work includes felt, patched cloth, hair-retaining hide, a girl's undergarment, worn fabric, prepared palm fiber, first folds, cushions, curtains, and a food mat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Felt, Wool, and Hair-Retaining Hide
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Hair or wool is retained, compacted, and worked into felt, patches, or a protected hide.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: felted wool and patched material `ل ب د:B001/m01`; hide retaining hair or fleece `ص ح ب:B006/m01`; compacting layers `ل ب د:B001/m02`; animal hair and wool contrast `ل ب د:B007/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The process begins with fiber still attached to hide or gathered loose, then uses pressure and layering to produce a dense, durable material.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person or group is assigned to the right or left side of an oriented field.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: right hand and right side `ي م ن:B002/m01`; left side `ش ء م:B001/m01`; human-facing side `ء ن س:B004/m01`; directional route `ه د ي:B002/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Blessing and Ill Omen
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Directional sides become signs of favorable or harmful outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: blessing and good fortune `ي م ن:B001/m01`; ill omen `ش ء م:B003/m01`; visible sign `ء ي ي:B003/m01`; consequence `ع ق ب:B006/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person or group is identified by regional direction, country, or tribal affiliation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Yemen and affiliation to it `ي م ن:B005/m01`; Syria and movement toward it `ش ء م:B002/m01`; Ghassan clan name `ص ب ر:B016/m01`; Himyarite chief or ruler `ق و ل:B004/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A moving body is oriented from leading front to following heel, and a dead body is finally laid on its right.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: vanguard or front point `ه د ي:B003/m01`; heel and rear `ع ق ب:B002/m01`; death laid on the right side `ي م ن:B007/m01`; burial soil `ت ر ب:B001/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Orientation persists across movement and death. The front leads, the heel follows, and burial fixes the body's final side against the soil.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Motion includes a horse's coordinated footfall, muzzle-prompted run, supported swaying, coquettish gait, camel travel for knowledge, dislodging an encampment, and persistent adhesion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Supported Sway and Composed Bearing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A weak or stylized walker sways, leans on companions, and may recover a calm bearing.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: supported swaying walk `ه د ي:B008/m01`; broken or coquettish sway `ه ل ك:B003/m01`; calm, unhurried bearing `ه د ي:B010/m01`; companion support `ص ح ب:B004/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Docility, Training, and Obedience
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A previously difficult person or animal yields to guidance and follows another's direction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Training converts resistance into coordinated following. The body lowers or yields, and guidance becomes effective because the subject now accepts direction.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin başka bir şeyle yakın ve süreğen biçimde birlikte bulunmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir. Kişi, hayvan, yer ve zamanla kurulan eşlik ilişkisi bu çekirdeğe girerken sahiplik, bir işin başında bulunma ve yanında bir eşlikçi bulunması belirli yapılara bağlı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Geçici bir karşılaşma yeterli değildir; anlam, görece sürekli eşlik veya yakın birliktelik gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eşlik çekirdeği ile sahiplik, görev ve bir eşlikçisi bulunma gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şeyle geçici olmayan biçimde birlikte bulunmak, ona eşlik etmek veya onunla yakınlığını sürdürmektir. Belirli yapılarda bir şeyin sahibi ya da sorumlusu olmayı ve kişinin yanında bir eşlikçi bulunmasını da anlatır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, iki tarafın yakın ve süreğen biçimde birlikte bulunması ya da birinin ötekine eşlik etmesidir.
Eşlik eden taraf kişi, hayvan, yer veya zamanla ilişkili olabilir; tekil eşlikçi ve eşlikçiler topluluğu da adlandırılabilir.
Belirli ad tamlamalarında bir şeyin sahibi, ona bağlı kişi veya onun işini yürüten sorumlu kastedilir.
Bir kişinin yanında kendisine eşlik eden birinin bulunması da bu anlam alanının yapıya bağlı uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, sıradan bir araya gelmeden daha güçlü olan yakın ve sürekli eşliktir; kişi adları, topluluk adları, sahiplik ve sorumluluk kullanımları bu çekirdeğin çevresinde yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, eşlik düşüncesini koruma sonucuna taşıyan kullanımları açıkça bir araya getirir. Bir kimsenin korunması ile ona eşlik eden dinginlik, iç güç ve yumuşak destek aynı koruyucu eşlik çerçevesinde yer alır; bu anlam sıradan iki kişilik arkadaşlık değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, koruma dilekleri ve eşlik ederek destek olma bağlamlarıyla sınırlıdır; genel arkadaşlık anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Koruma dileği bildiren kalıp sözler ile birine dinginlik ve destek eşlik etmesini anlatan bağlama bağlı kullanım ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseyi eşlik eden bir gözetimle korumak veya ona dinginlik, iç güç ve yumuşak destek ulaştırmaktır. Anlam özellikle koruma dileklerinde ve bu tür desteğin kişiye eşlik ettiği bağlamlarda gerçekleşir.
